text:
maria: Quick heads-up — PR #4829 updates Console -> Dashboards (cost/latency heuristics) and the Playground sample that demos trace->cost mapping. Need a quick pass: one broken link, one SDK snippet rename, and an example output mismatch. Can we triage today? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

andre: On it. I hit a 404 on the 'trace-map guide' link in the dashboard doc. PR currently points to /docs/tracing/trace-map — should be /console/tracing/trace-mapping. I can push a tiny redirect/fix.

samir: Noted — the Python SDK example in the playground still uses `trace_key` (old param). New SDK uses `trace_id`. I'll update the snippet and add a short migration note.

jess: I can run the playground smoke tests. Which env do you want me to use — staging or preview? Also noticed the dashboard heatmap preview orders buckets differently than prod in my local Safari. Could be a rendering quirk.

maria: Use the preview build URL attached to the PR. @jess please run the preview smoke tests. @andre please fix the link. @samir update the snippet. If you see any output mismatch, add a tiny failing example under examples/tests/ so we don't regress.

andre: Quick patch pushed to the branch — replaced the bad link and adjusted the TOC anchor. Commit msg: "Fix: redirect 404 -> console/tracing/trace-mapping"

docs-bot: PR #4829 created by maria with 3 commits. CI: docs-lint ✅, preview build queued.

samir: Snippet updated and short note added. New example (python):

```python
from redwood import ConsoleClient
client = ConsoleClient()
client.trace.annotate(trace_id="abc123", cost_breakdown=True)
```

I added a 'migration note' block pointing to the SDK changelog instead of a long explanation.

jess: Ran preview smoke tests: playground rendering looks good, link is fixed, but heatmap ordering still reversed on Safari. Uploaded screenshot to the PR and left steps to reproduce.

maria: Thanks — if heatmap ordering is a browser quirk, we should add a short note in the docs and open a follow-up ticket to metrics; not a merge blocker. Anyone opposed to merging after CI is green?

andre: +1. Left one tiny wording nit in the cost heuristics paragraph (suggested phrasing in PR comment).

samir: +1 from me.

jess: +1. I'll open the follow-up issue for the heatmap ordering (DEV-7891) and link it in the PR.

maria: Merging after green. I'll backfill the changelog entry and ping the release notes channel once it's live. :tada:
